# File-Only Logger v0.2.70 - Table of Contents

> A simple logger that writes messages to log files only (not to the console).

## Modules

- [File.Only.Logger](https://file-only-logger.hexdocs.pm/File.Only.Logger.md): A simple logger that writes messages to log files only (not to the console).

- [File.Only.Logger.App](https://file-only-logger.hexdocs.pm/File.Only.Logger.App.md)
- [File.Only.Logger.Config](https://file-only-logger.hexdocs.pm/File.Only.Logger.Config.md)
- [File.Only.Logger.Log](https://file-only-logger.hexdocs.pm/File.Only.Logger.Log.md)
- [File.Only.Logger.Proxy](https://file-only-logger.hexdocs.pm/File.Only.Logger.Proxy.md): Implements logging messages to files only (not to the console).
